title: Repo Health - Test Drilldown (v16)
description: Health check for one repository: its slowest tests, its biggest slowdowns, and a drilldown timeline for any tests you select. Pick your repository first; click any test name in the tables to add it to the timeline at the bottom.

spec.description: How many test + server-version combinations are currently being tracked.
spec.title: Tests tracked

spec.description: How many tests are slower right now than they used to be. A test counts only if all three are true: it is more than the chosen threshold slower than its usual duration, the slowdown is at least 1 second of real time, and there is enough history (10+ past measurements) to be confident. 0 means everything is running at its normal speed.
spec.title: Regressed tests now

spec.description: How long ago this repository last reported test results. If this grows beyond a day or two, the CI pipeline or the metrics reporting is probably broken - fix that before trusting the rest of this dashboard.
spec.title: Hours since last run

spec.expr:
sum(
  last_over_time(cae_v16_test_run_duration_seconds{vcs_repository_name=~"$repository", server_version=~"$server_version", vcs_repository_ref_name=~"$branch"}[$recent])
)
or vector(0)

spec.description: Combined duration of the latest test runs for the selected repository, summed across server versions.
spec.title: Total test time (latest runs)

spec.description: The 100 slowest tests in this repository (typical duration over the recent window), one row per test per server version. Click a test name to add it to the timeline at the bottom.
spec.title: Top 100 slowest tests

spec.description: The 100 tests that changed most against their own history (before a baseline exists: the slowest). Click a test name to add it to the timeline at the bottom.
spec.title: Top 100 movers vs their own history

spec.description: Duration over time for the tests you selected - one line per server version. Add tests by clicking names in the tables above, or via the Test ID selector. Each point is the slowest run of that day, so spikes stay visible.
spec.title: Duration timeline for selected tests

spec.description: Exact numbers for the tests currently shown in the timeline: typical recent duration, baseline, change and verdict per server version.
spec.title: Selected tests - details
